quest.title: Homecoming's Faint Glow
quest.description: The kuuhenki are up to something interesting in the Silvermoon Hall...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm. The atmosphere's a little unusual today. Are you decorating this flower field, Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Ah, that wasn't me. It was them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean... the kuuhenki?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Yes. These stones emit a faint light upon absorbing kuuvahki. The kuuhenki are quite fond of them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So they just... put them on the ground and play with them?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Not exactly. Come over here and look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! It forms a picture when you look at it from above!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like we're a chunk short, though...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: That's right. I need to go collect some more.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so you're heading out?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Yes, I know just the place — it's graced by the moon, so these kinds of stones are abundant.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Want us to come with?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, then let's get collecting! We wanna see what the finished picture looks like, too!

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to collect ores

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should be enough, right? Feels like we grabbed a whole bunch.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, let's head back. Can't leave that artwork incomplete forever, right?

dialogues.speaker: Rijeka
dialogues.text: *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaahh! Quick, hide! Someone's here!

dialogues.speaker: Rijeka
dialogues.text: *sob* Where am I... Mommy... I wanna go home...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like she's one of the Frostmoon Scions. Is she lost?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go help her...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: You will?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, of course! She sure looks like she needs it!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: The Frostmoon Scions are deeply wary of outsiders, correct? You have no antlers, the hour is late... What if you scare her off instead...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, that could happen, but we can't just do nothing!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hmm... Come with me, then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

talks.objective: Use ore to create a guide back to the path

dialogues.speaker: Rijeka
dialogues.text: *whimper* ... Huh? What's this...

dialogues.speaker: Rijeka
dialogues.text: It's... so pretty...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: That should do it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And off she goes. That trail of stone should lead her back to the Frostmoon Enclave.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Columbina says she doesn't want to be treated like a god, but she helps those in need all the same...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, but what about the painting...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: It's alright.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: We can finish it some other time.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I like watching people find their way back home, to the place where they belong.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: A little to the left.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: A little to the right.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Mmm. Yes. Well done.
